problems.reason: Both sentences state that Zhao Xijin described Klamelisaurus gobiensis in 1993.
All three sentences describe Zhao’s 1993 classification of Klamelisaurus as the sole member of the subfamily Klamelisaurinae.

Sentence 24 claims the species lived during the Middle Jurassic (Callovian), while sentences 11 and 25 place the holotype in the Oxfordian stage, which is Late Jurassic.
